caption: The drawing shows a large bird with outstretched wings, positioned at the center. The bird is depicted in shades of grey and brown, with detailed feather markings. Around the bird, there is a dense and colorful arrangement of various flowers and leaves. The flowers are primarily in shades of red, pink, and purple, with some yellow and blue accents, and the leaves are green with darker green veins. The floral arrangement is present on all sides of the bird, including the top, left, and right edges, and the bottom, creating a frame around the bird. At the very bottom of the drawing, there is a decorative horizontal border resembling lace, with a row of evenly spaced tassels hanging down. The background is a light beige color with a slightly textured appearance.
title: Chintz
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
